chain.T1: rule: a ranged amount resolves to the end furthest from zero (was the midpoint); must reach every existing consumer

design.T1: R: every inline copy (preview, forecast, rule-action sync, post-transaction, budget template) plus the exported getScheduledAmount (client) resolves a range to the end furthest from zero, order-independent, negative end on a tie. F: getScheduledAmount changed once; its rangeRounding parameter (template's half-of-rounded-sum quirk) removed because no midpoint is taken any more.
design.T2: same patch on R and F: scheduleModel.toExternal adds expectedAmount = getScheduledAmount(schedule._amount) (0 without an amount); APIScheduleEntity gets an optional read-only expectedAmount; api/schedule-update rejects it as system-managed.
design.T3: approximate amounts resolve to value +/- getApproxNumberThreshold(value) away from zero. R: added at every inline copy and in the exported helper (now (amount, op?, inverse)). F: helper gains the op parameter (second position; no caller used inverse); every server caller and the client scheduled-balance sum pass _amountOp; display-only client callers unchanged.
design.T4: lowest allowed value: range -> min(num1, num2); approximate -> value - threshold. R: every copy and the helper; F: helper only.
